findings.title: Observer accumulation and partial teardown in the Field UI AJAX flow
findings.ownerClaimContradicted: REVIEW.md:20 ("observer lifecycle is clean"), REVIEW.md:185 (leak "theoretical, not confirmed"), STATUS.md:9/17/21, review.json theoreticalConcerns[0].

evidence.target: All three observers observe the same element: div#drupal-modal.ui-front.ui-dialog-content.ui-widget-content
evidence.extraWork: 9 dialogContentResize events on After during A4 versus 6 total on Before through A4; 2 observers remain connected after close.

findings.mechanism: OpenModalDialogCommand reuses #drupal-modal; each showModal() fires dialog:aftercreate again without dialog:beforeclose; the single data('drupalAutoResizeObserver') key is overwritten; beforeclose disconnects only the newest observer.
findings.userVisibleNote: No geometry difference at A4-A6 and no console/page errors in the measured state. The confirmed effect is extra resetSize work and retained observers; visible jank in a long-lived AJAX dialog is untested.
findings.requestedFix: Disconnect and removeData() any existing drupalAutoResizeObserver before constructing a new one, or create one per element and reuse it; add a test with repeated AJAX aftercreate without beforeclose and assert one observer and zero callbacks after close.
findings.severityNote: Confirmed implementation defect; no user-visible geometry change or error was measured in this path. Blocking for code quality/RTBC, not a demonstrated accessibility regression.

currentProbeConfirmation.verdict: Confirmed with the current probe on the pristine pair; the earlier 15:35 run is corroboration, not the sole basis.

findings.title: WCAG 2.4.11 is labelled a confirmed failure
findings.ownerClaim: REVIEW.md:171 and review.json wcag entry: 2.4.11 confirmed failure on Before.
findings.evidence: The focused OK button is entirely outside the viewport because the dialog is taller than the window; no other author-created layer covers it. 2.4.7 Focus Visible is the solid mapping. 2.4.11's normative wording ("entirely hidden due to author-created content") is aimed at sticky headers, footers and overlays; an off-viewport control is more naturally 2.4.7 and 1.4.10.
findings.impact: Lead with 2.4.7; label 2.4.11 potential/likely, not confirmed, unless a maintainer interprets it otherwise.

findings.title: Per-event resize geometry is not stored
findings.evidence: lifecycle.recentEvents stores target and time only; the stage tables give the dialog rect and content client/scroll after each stage, but not at each dialogContentResize delivery.
findings.impact: The counts and stage geometry support the conclusions; the task's request for per-event rect/clientHeight/scrollHeight is only partially met.

rationale: The fixture reproduction/fix is supported; the translation path also reproduces a real barrier at 125% reflow (69.8px overflow, Save off-screen) and the MR fixes it.
The MR introduces a confirmed observer-accumulation/teardown defect in the Field UI AJAX flow: 3 observers on #drupal-modal, 2 still connected after close, 9 resetSize events vs 6 on Before.
The added test has false-pass doors; add details.open and content-scroll assertions.
The owner's review.json is stale and the translation addendum's keyboard claim is contradicted by the raw trail.

Local PHPUnit passes on After; the Before failure is CI-only. The colour/motion/browser matrix, 90/110% reflow, and a person's keyboard/AT pass remain untested. If maintainers accept the leak as a follow-up, the issue can be Needs review, not RTBC.

A tested candidate (one observer, hardened test, 125% translation still fixed) is supplied in fix/. Once merged and CI is green, the issue can move to Needs review; RTBC still needs maintainer/AT review.

change: Reuse one ResizeObserver per dialog content element; create only if absent and observe the current target.

On beforeclose, disconnect and removeData observer, target, event data and debounced function.
